description: What a call would cost before placing it: to (E.164), optional from (one of the brand's numbers) and minutes (default 1). Twilio: its own per-minute rate for that destination, read live; Hermoso phone: the credits a minute. Telnyx publishes no per-number price over its API, so its rate page is named instead. Recording, transcription and a place_call bridge's second leg are extra. Free. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: estimate_call_cost
title: Estimate a call's cost
